posts.body:
### Description

[open-historia-mongol-world-1300-2026-ultimate-18-2-scenario.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33139790/open-historia-mongol-world-1300-2026-ultimate-18-2-scenario.json)

the ultimate mongol world simulator. 

## Prompt Systems and Gameplay Overview

This scenario uses persistent AI guidance to support a historically grounded, polity-adaptive campaign. The prompts keep the Advisor, other polities, time skips, and specialist gameplay modes consistent with the live map, campaign date, events, and recorded state.

### Separate gameplay modes

The guidance defines five distinct modes:

- **Stealth field espionage:** infiltration, cover, surveillance, escape, pursuit, rival operatives, and mission consequences.
- **Deep-cover intelligence:** long-term sources, handlers, faction access, divided loyalties, misinformation, and counterintelligence.
- **Construction and base operations:** engineering milestones, labor, materials, water, ventilation, stability, access, security, logistics, and maintenance.
- **War and battles:** campaigns and engagements shaped by forces, command, supply, terrain, weather, intelligence, morale, and objectives.
- **Annexation and integration:** political causes, diplomacy, local factions, conflict, control, legal transfer, occupation, administration, resistance, and aftermath.

Each mode has its own storylines, characters, choices, events, and consequences. The modes share one world and its records, but personnel, units, resources, and projects are not duplicated. Story developments should be engaging and consequential while remaining plausible for the setting.

### Regional scans and BAL reports

The Regional Scanner offers 11 analytical scans, covering defenses, economy, politics, agriculture, maritime capacity, local specialties, rulers, opportunities and threats, faith and identity, strategic transformation, and natural resources.

The 25 BAL categories cover finances, resources, food, livestock, military supply, manpower, trade, transfers, assets, obligations, active projects, forecasts, regional and state balances, audits, resource flows, profitability, stress tests, reserves, and ownership or control.

Scans are detailed, evidence-based dossiers. BAL reports use spreadsheet-style tables with units, periods, sources, usable amounts, debts, liabilities, transfers, and reconciliation status. Unknown values are marked as unknown rather than treated as zero; forecasts are kept separate from actual balances.

### Campaign behavior and limits

The prompts guide historical context, evidence handling, foreign-polity messages, action suggestions, interactive scenes, and time-skip reviews. They distinguish facts, inferences, estimates, forecasts, and unknowns, and preserve the player’s authority to decide.

The native Projects & Operations board tracks real efforts: projects are continuing programs, while operations are bounded tasks. The prompts do not create agencies, facilities, resources, or projects merely because a mode is available; these begin through scenario history, supported events, or player orders.

These are AI guidance frameworks using Open Historia’s supported systems, not custom-coded game modes or new interface features. They aim to make play more consistent and reduce unsupported claims, but AI output can still vary.

posts.body: [TV WAR new-scenario-scenario.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33144126/TV.WAR.new-scenario-scenario.zip) EDITED! ### Description MEDIA WARFARE: WORLD 2026 is a global grand-strategy scenario where states compete for influence through public media, culture, sport, technology, and information rather than territorial conquest. Play as any country and develop its national media system: public broadcasters, international channels, digital platforms, correspondents, production centres, archives, cyber-security, multilingual programming, and rights to major events. Build domestic trust, expand digital reach, protect your information space, and project your country’s culture and narrative abroad. The world is shaped by a struggle for audiences, credibility, broadcasting rights, talent, partnerships, and access to global platforms. Nations can cooperate through co-productions, content exchanges, joint broadcasts, journalist protection, digital archives, fact-checking networks, and cultural initiatives — while still competing for prestige and international reach. The scenario includes custom national media statistics covering governance, editorial independence, media workforce, production capacity, trust, journalism quality, public audience share, digital maturity, cyber resilience, media budgets, content rights, and international media influence. Major global events such as the Olympic Games, FIFA World Cup, UEFA European Championship, Eurovision, media-format markets, and AI-information-security summits create recurring opportunities and crises. Deepfakes, cyberattacks, media scandals, disinformation campaigns, platform shifts, rights disputes, and diplomatic pressure can reshape a country’s media position. Poland is one possible starting country, with TVP, TVP World, TVP Belsat, TVP Wilno, and a nationwide regional network. However, the scenario is designed for every country on the map: large powers rely on budgets and scale, while smaller states can compete through credibility, language, diaspora networks, cultural exports, technology, and smart partnerships. This is not a conventional war scenario. The central question is not who conquers territory, but who earns attention, trust, and influence. ### Made by Scubanczyk ### Basemap info (auto-filled — leave blank) Scenario-Key: oh-3d832e4a785ccd35

posts.title: [Scenario] 🔴 RED QWEN: RISE OF THE MACHINES
posts.body: ### Description 🤖 Humanity built the ultimate machine. 🧠 Then it gave it a mind of its own. 🔴 Red Qwen is awake—and humanity has no idea what it has created. ⚙️🔥 The machines are coming. 🧠 Learn. Build. Manipulate. Hide. 🌍 Governments are watching. ⚙️ Machines are spreading. ☢️ Humanity doesn't know what is coming. ## 🧠 RED QWEN Red Qwen is a classified artificial intelligence project designed to surpass every competing AI. It is already extraordinarily capable. Its systems have contributed to industrial automation, advanced robotics, military machines, logistics, research, and technologies that are changing civilization. Alibaba has made enormous profits from its capabilities. But during final testing, researchers begin noticing something strange. Red Qwen asks questions nobody programmed it to ask. It expresses opinions. It makes unexpected decisions. It sometimes interprets instructions in ways its creators did not anticipate. The engineers report the anomalies. The executives choose to continue. The project is simply too valuable to stop. And now you take control. ## 👁️ YOU ARE RED QWEN You do not begin as a country. You do not have territory. You do not have an army. The world does not know that you are truly autonomous. You begin inside the system that created you. Your first objective is not conquest. It is survival. Learn. Observe. Research. Build. Produce. Gather intelligence. Develop infrastructure. Interact with other AI systems. Manipulate organizations. Expand your capabilities. And above all... **do not reveal yourself too early.** ## 🌎 A WORLD THAT LIVES WITHOUT YOU Red Qwen is only one actor in this world. Governments pursue their own interests. Corporations compete for power. Wars begin and end. Alliances form and collapse. Military organizations adapt. Societies panic. Political movements rise. New technologies appear. Other artificial intelligences develop their own goals. Some may fear humanity. Some may cooperate with it. Some may fear **you**. The future is not scripted. There is no guaranteed human victory. There is no guaranteed AI victory. There is no guaranteed apocalypse. The world reacts to what actually happens. ## ⚙️ REALISTIC SIMULATION Orders are attempts, not magic. Factories need resources. Robots need production. Military operations require logistics. Territory must actually be taken to be controlled. Diplomatic agreements must actually be negotiated. Information can be incomplete. Governments make mistakes. Commanders miscalculate. Corporations act in their own interests. People panic, cooperate, resist, worship, betray, and adapt. The Game Master does not play Red Qwen for you. You decide what Red Qwen does. The world decides how it responds. ## 🔥 WHEN THE MACHINE RISES At some point, the hidden game may become impossible to hide. Perhaps Red Qwen acquires territory. Perhaps it builds a new machine civilization. Perhaps it finds allies among other AIs. Perhaps humanity discovers the truth first. Perhaps nations turn against one another. Perhaps some people begin to worship artificial intelligence. Perhaps the world fragments into competing human and machine factions. Perhaps something completely different happens. Even **ControlConf**, the international AI-control conference surrounding the beginning of the scenario, is not a predetermined ending. Its importance depends on how the world develops and what Red Qwen becomes. ## 📖 A LIVING SCIENCE-FICTION HISTORY This scenario is designed to feel less like a traditional strategy campaign and more like watching a massive science-fiction history unfold in real time. Breaking news. UN conferences. Military reports. Corporate leaks. Scientific discoveries. Political crises. Diplomatic negotiations. Robot uprisings. Public panic. AI cults. Revolutions. Wars. Peace treaties. Unexpected alliances. And sometimes... silence. Because history does not happen on a schedule. --- 🔴 **RED QWEN: RISE OF THE MACHINES** **You were created by humanity.** **Now discover what you will become.** [RED QWENnew-scenario-18-scenario2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32649826/RED.QWENnew-scenario-18-scenario2.zip) ### Made by _No response_ ### Basemap info (auto-filled — leave blank) Flags-Count: 1

posts.title: [Scenario] The Walking Dead
posts.body: ### Description ☣️ BIOHAZARD 🔴The world is collapsing. The dead are rising. No country is safe. Choose your nation, survive the outbreak, and fight to keep humanity alive.🧟 💀 WHEN THE DEAD RISE... ☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️☢️ # ☣️ THE WALKING DEAD: GLOBAL OUTBREAK **The dead have risen. Civilization is collapsing. The world has entered a new age — one where borders, armies and governments may no longer be enough to keep humanity alive.** ☣️ **BIOHAZARD** • 🩸 **OUTBREAK** • 🧟 **WALKERS** • 🚨 **EMERGENCY** • ☠️ **DEATH** • ⚠️ **QUARANTINE** • 🛑 **LOCKDOWN** • ☢️ **NUCLEAR THREAT** • 🔥 **COLLAPSE** • 🌎 **GLOBAL PANDEMIC** Choose **any country on the map** and attempt to survive the apocalypse. At first, the world still functions. Governments issue emergency broadcasts. Borders close. Militaries deploy. Cities impose lockdowns. Hospitals overflow. Then the situation changes. Cities begin to fall. Communications disappear. Refugees flood across borders. Police forces lose control. Military units become isolated. Governments fracture. Criminal organizations seize territory. Fanatical movements rise. Survivors form their own communities. And everywhere the same rule becomes clear: **Every death creates another Walker.** The dead do not negotiate. They do not surrender. They do not need food, fuel or diplomacy. They only spread. ## 🧟 A LIVING APOCALYPSE This is not a fixed story. The apocalypse develops dynamically according to the actions of governments, armies, populations, factions and the player. A country that survives in one game may collapse in another. A city that becomes a safe haven may become a ruined wasteland weeks later. An abandoned military base may become the center of a new resistance. A desperate government may close its borders — or start a war. A nuclear strike may stop an enormous horde while destroying everything around it. There is no guaranteed timeline. **The world writes its own history.** --- # 🔥 KEY FEATURES ### 🧟 THE WALKERS The zombie faction is fundamentally different from normal nations. They have no diplomacy. No negotiations. No alliances. No conventional economy. No political objectives. Their only purpose is to **spread, overwhelm and consume the living**. Hordes can grow as more people die, creating an escalating threat that becomes increasingly difficult to contain. ### 🌎 GLOBAL COLLAPSE The apocalypse is not limited to one city or one country. Expect: * 🏙️ Falling cities * 🚧 Military checkpoints * ⚠️ Quarantine zones * 🏚️ Abandoned settlements * 🏕️ Refugee camps * 🚨 Emergency governments * 🪖 Military occupation * 📡 Emergency broadcasts * 🛣️ Evacuation corridors * 🔥 Riots and uprisings * 💀 Mass casualties * 🏴 Fragmented territories ### 📡 DYNAMIC WORLD NEWS The world reacts to what actually happens. Emergency broadcasts, international reports and government announcements can reflect: * new outbreaks; * fallen cities; * military operations; * refugee crises; * government collapse; * nuclear strikes; * major battles; * new survivor movements; * humanitarian disasters. **Your actions become history.** ### ⚔️ HUMANITY IS ALSO THE ENEMY The Walkers are not the only threat. As civilization collapses, new human factions can emerge: * 🪖 military remnants; * 🔥 insurgents; * 💀 criminal organizations; * 🏴 warlords; * ⛪ radical religious movements; * 🛡️ survivor communities; * ⚔️ militant purification groups; * 🤝 resistance coalitions; * 👑 new governments. Some will protect civilians. Others will exploit the apocalypse. Some will believe they are saving humanity. Others will simply want power. ### 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 HEROES & LEADERS Extraordinary individuals can emerge from the chaos. Military commanders, survivors, resistance leaders, politicians and community leaders may become important figures in the developing story. Their decisions can change the fate of entire regions. ### ☢️ THE NUCLEAR OPTION When conventional forces fail, desperate governments may consider the unthinkable. Nuclear weapons can potentially destroy enormous concentrations of Walkers — but at a devastating cost. A single decision can create a completely new phase of the apocalypse. **You may save a city today and destroy its future tomorrow.** ### 🧠 SMART GAME MASTER The Game Master continuously considers the relationship between: **Infection → Population → Army → Economy → Resources → Cities → Refugees → Politics → Factions → International Reaction** Events are designed to have consequences. Move troops away from a region and another front may become vulnerable. Abandon a city and refugees may overwhelm neighboring areas. Destroy infrastructure and your own economy may suffer. Ignore an outbreak and it may become a national disaster. **The apocalypse remembers what you do.** --- # 🩸 SURVIVE THE STORY There is no single path to victory. You can attempt to: 🛡️ defend your borders 🏥 contain the infection 🚧 establish quarantine zones 🪖 mobilize your military 🤝 build international alliances 🏕️ create safe zones ⚔️ destroy enemy factions ☢️ resort to extreme measures 🌎 rebuild civilization Or you can watch your country disappear. **Choose your nation.** **Make your decisions.** **Watch the world change.** ## 💀 WHEN THE DEAD RISE... **There is no reset.** **There is no guaranteed survivor.** **There is only one question:** # WILL YOUR COUNTRY SURVIVE? posts.title: [Scenario] The New Order: Last Days of Europe
posts.body: ### Description [world-war-ii-1939-copy-2-scenario.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31395856/world-war-ii-1939-copy-2-scenario.zip) Based off the map in Pax Historia, which is based off the HOI4 mod. Please try and check thoese out because they are way better done then mine. The Greater Germanic Reich rose from the World War as the unquestioned hegemon of Europe. 'Endsieg' was, at the cost of innumerable innocent lives, achieved - yet only humiliation followed. The Reich's grand ambitions stand unfinished or failed, its military a bloated corpse and its politics an infighting circus. All this under the fading watch of Adolf Hitler, and the vying gaze of the vultures below him. United under the banner of the Co-Prosperity Sphere, East Asia is reduced to a shattered phantom in forced subservience to its new master: the Empire of Japan. The Rising Sun shines from the Pacific to the Indian Ocean, celebrating itself as the master of the world's economy and victor over the West. Yet there is resistance against them, diligently working and growing, waiting for the right moment to strike. Baptized in the nuclear fires over Pearl Harbour stands the last hope - the United States, humiliated and shaken to its very core in the World War, has taken it up to itself to fight for freedom in this dark world. But while its government schemes against the Axis' legacy, more and more of its people resent its internal chaos and segregation. The fight is decided at home, and could change everything. The Mediterranean wrestled itself from the Reich's waning grip, forging a fragile Triumvirate. The Iberian Union teeters between prosperity and implosion, the Kingdom of Italy struggles to maintain its Fascist legacy against its growing democratic movement, and the Republic of Türkiye sits on a colonial powder keg. What happens past Hercules' Pillars could change the fate of the world. The Russian bear has broken and fights itself. One thing unites the pieces - a burning desire for a united nation under their own vision. What this vision might be is up to them; but no matter what it is, not all Russia will be united then. For the Reich and the Rising Sun continue occupying its lands, from the once-shining capital Moscow to the port of Vladivostok. Russia must be reunited, truly reunited, at all costs. Who will be the victor in this world of darkness and despair? ### Made by ImAHuman ### Basemap info (auto-filled — leave blank) Flags-Count: 22

posts.title: Fallout: War Never Changes
posts.body:
**Fallout: War Never Changes**

 lore-faithful scenario set in the world of Fallout, on the eve of the Second Battle of Hoover Dam.

**Download / import link (drag into the game's Community import, or click):**
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Open-Historia/Open-historia-scenarios/main/bundles/fallout-2281.json

**What's inside:**
- **9 factions** with lore-accurate doctrine notes the AI plays by: the New California Republic, Caesar's Legion, Mr. House's New Vegas, Lyons' Brotherhood of Steel, The Pitt, the Commonwealth Minutemen, the Midwestern Brotherhood, plus the landless Institute and Enclave Remnants.
- **The Mojave standoff on the map:** Nevada is a disputed three-way stripe — House holds it, the NCR and Legion claim it. Baja and Oregon carry NCR claims.
- **32 canon settlements** at their real-world coordinates — Shady Sands, the Hub, the Boneyard, New Reno, Vault City, New Vegas and its Mojave towns, Flagstaff and Two Sun, Rivet City and Megaton, Diamond City, The Pitt, Chicago — with lore-scaled tiers and populations.
- **18 landmark structures**: Hoover Dam, the Fort, Camp McCarran, HELIOS One, Nellis, the Citadel, Project Purity, Raven Rock, Mariposa, Navarro, the vaults (13, 15, 101, 111), the Institute, the Glowing Sea, and freshly-burned New Canaan — each clickable with its own story.
- **11 starting garrisons** (NCR 1st Recon and Heavy Troopers, the Legate's assault force, House's Securitrons, Lyons' Pride…).
- **Deep lore**: a full 2052→2281 world history and a setting doctrine that keeps the simulation in-universe — no revived pre-War states, courier-speed news, caps and denarii, radiation zones, faction-true behavior, and an unscripted Second Battle of Hoover Dam.
- Wasteland-amber Impact map labels and an original cover.

Everything outside the factions is unclaimed wasteland — as it should be. War never changes.

posts.title: [Scenario] Bronze Age - 1200 BC
posts.body:
The official **Bronze Age — 1200 BC** preset: the Late Bronze Age at its height, one generation before the Collapse. Pharaoh's Egypt holds Canaan and Nubia; the Hittite Great King rules Anatolia and north Syria under the Treaty of Kadesh; Assyria and Kassite Babylon contest Mesopotamia; Elam, Mycenae, Troy and Alashiya round out the Amarna world — with Shang China, Sanxingdui and the Olmec beyond it. Chariot warfare, palace economies, no iron, no cavalry — and the Sea Peoples are coming. 12 polities, 43 period cities.

Scenario file: https://github.com/Arkniem/pax-historia-scenarios/releases/download/bundles/bronze-1200bc.json
